    When getColonies is called with a character ID
    Then the client shall return an array of colonies with planet details

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getColonies returns no results, the client shall return an empty array
    Given the ESI PI colonies endpoint returns no colonies
    When getColonies is called with a character ID that has no colonies
    Then the client shall return an empty array

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getColonyLayout is called, the client shall return pins, links, and routes
    Given the ESI PI colony layout endpoint is available
    When getColonyLayout is called with a character ID and planet ID
    Then the client shall return a layout containing pins, links, and routes

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getColonyLayout is called for an empty colony, the client shall return empty arrays
    Given the ESI PI colony layout endpoint returns an empty layout

    Then the client shall return empty arrays for pins, links, and routes

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getSchematicInformation is called, the client shall return schematic details
    Given the ESI PI schematic endpoint is available
    When getSchematicInformation is called with a schematic ID
    Then the client shall return schematic details including name and cycle time

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF schematic ID does not exist, THEN the client shall throw an EsiError with status 404
    Given the ESI PI schematic endpoint returns a 404 for an invalid ID
    When getSchematicInformation is called with an invalid schematic ID
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 404

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getCorporationCustomsOffices is called, the client shall return a list of customs offices
    Given the ESI PI customs offices endpoint is available
    When getCorporationCustomsOffices is called with a corporation ID
    Then the client shall return an array of customs offices with office details

  # EARS: Unwanted behavior
  Scenario: IF permissions are insufficient for customs offices, THEN the client shall throw an EsiError with status 403
    Given the ESI PI customs offices endpoint rejects unauthorized requests
    When getCorporationCustomsOffices is called without sufficient permissions
    Then the client shall throw an EsiError with status 403

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN colonies and layouts are retrieved sequentially, the client shall return complete PI data
    Given the ESI PI colonies and colony layout endpoints are available
    When getColonies and getColonyLayout are called sequentially
    Then the client shall return complete PI data including colonies and layouts
"}
